evidence: Initializes Scream audio configuration from the verified INI path at guest address 0x7001cfb67f (Audio\SCREAMINIT.INI), then stores/loads the verified NSWDEMO\Audio\BANK_STREAMS path at 0x7001cc97f8: decompiled/main/main_0030.c:48471-48490, :48533-48554. Its observed caller is decompiled/main/main_0030.c:48244.

Inspected the switch-driven field decoder in decompiled/main/main_0084.c:36919-37091. It dispatches by a format/type table and reads fields at multiple offsets, but the queue's CARD%d/tbFlags cues are not direct strings used by this body; no callers were observed, so a domain-specific rename is unsupported.

Checks the DD_LINEUP_DATA property, scans its entry array and accesses each entry's position property before storing the matching result: decompiled/main/main_0079.c:5932-5954, :5964-5986, :6007-6012. Full guest addresses 0x7001d21e84 and 0x7001d17fbb resolve to DD_LINEUP_DATA and position. No callers were observed.

Looks up MatchupList and total_pages, increments the current page counter at object offset 0xb0 modulo the total-page count, and resets it on failed/missing lookup: decompiled/main/main_0078.c:33310-33338. Full guest strings 0x7001c4bccc and 0x7001d34de1 resolve to MatchupList and total_pages. No callers were observed.

Checks for nested texture/textures properties, then passes the resulting map and metadata object to f_7000a1eae0: decompiled/main/main_0068.c:9923-9947. Full guest addresses 0x7001ce66af and 0x7001d04ddb resolve to texture and textures. No callers were observed.

Checks CURRENT_PLAYER then its type_id property and converts a zero value through a helper: decompiled/main/main_0084.c:17169-17191. Guest strings at 0x7001d50068 and 0x7001d587b0 resolve as CURRENT_PLAYER and type_id, but this is insufficient to tell whether the routine validates, filters or updates a current-player record. No callers were observed.

Looks up current_row, then ref_id, and converts the resulting integer through f_7000a96738: decompiled/main/main_0078.c:33280-33294. Full guest strings 0x7001cd5670 and 0x7001d593e0 resolve to current_row and ref_id. No callers were observed.

Passes the verified DraftView Pool name at guest address 0x7001cfdc7b to f_700055b900 to create a named region, then allocates and stores two pool objects: decompiled/main/main_0087.c:36039-36079. Observed caller: decompiled/main/main_0087.c:38167.
